c.h: 氵 is a component form of 水.
Depicts the rippling surface of water.

沒.o: Depicts a hand reaching in the water to grab something. The meaning later expanded to "drown", "disappear", and "not have".
沒.om: reach into the water to grab something

c.h: Depicts the gap between the bones in an infant skull.

兒.o: Pictograph of a child (人) with an opening in the top of its head (囟). Represents the soft spot (fontanel) at the top of young infant heads. The 囟 component is written like 臼.

c.h: 氵 is a component form of 水.
Pictograph of a container for wine.

酒.o: Phonosemantic compound. 氵 represents the meaning and 酉 represents the sound.
w: baijiu, a spirit usually distilled from sorghum
x: 你干吗不喝点酒？
Nǐ gànmá bù hē diǎn jiǔ?
How come you don't wanna have a sip of alcohol?
此酒吧禁止未成年入内。
Cǐ jiǔba jìnzhǐ wèichéngnián rùnèi.
Minors are not permitted to enter this bar.
请来两杯啤酒。
Qǐng lái liǎng bēi píjiǔ.
Two beers, please.

棒.o: Phonosemantic compound. 木 represents the meaning and 奉 represents the sound.
x: 这篇文章写得多棒啊，背下来。
Zhè piān wénzhāng xiě de duō bàng a, bèi xiàlái.
How excellently written is this article! Learn it by heart.
我男朋友真的是太棒啦。
Wǒ nánpéngyou zhēnde shì tài bàng la.
My boyfriend is really awesome.

青.o: Phonosemantic compound. 生 represents the meaning and 井 represents the sound.
w: to fix one's gaze on; to show interest in
x: 他弟弟是位小有名气的青年歌手。
Tā dìdi shì wèi xiǎo yǒu míngqì de qīngnián gēshǒu.
His little brother is a popular young local singer.
这个青年人我见过，他有常人不及的气质。
Zhè ge qīngniánrén wǒ jiàn guò, tā yǒu chángrén bùjí de qìzhì.
This young person, who I have seen before, has an aura that cannot be matched by ordinary people.

c.h: 刂 is a component form of 刀.

划.o: Phonosemantic compound. 刂 represents the meaning and 戈 represents the sound. In simplified Chinese 划 is also used to mean "cut, delimit, draw", while in traditional Chinese this meaning is written with a separate character 劃.
w: to plan (how to do sth); planning; plan
to row or paddle boat; to scratch
to plot; to scheme; to bring about
to divide up; to partition; to differentiate
to calculate; to weigh (pros and cons)
x: 他把任务划给这个小组负责。
Tā bǎ rènwù huà gěi zhè ge xiǎozǔ fùzé.
He assigned the task to that group.
计划跟不上变化。
Jìhuà gēnbushàng biànhuà.
No plan can anticipate every possible change.
计划因资金不足而流产。
Jìhuà yīn zījīn bùzú ér liúchǎn.
The plan fell through due to a shortage of funding.

毒.o: Depicts a plant (屮) that is not good (毐), i.e. a poisonous plant.
x: 外面的太阳很毒。
Wàimiàn de tàiyáng hěn dú.
The sun outside is very fierce.
电脑中病毒了。
Diànnǎo zhòng bìngdú le.
The computer is infected with a virus.
珍惜生命，拒绝毒品。
Zhēnxī shēngmìng, jùjué dúpǐn.
Cherish life, say no to drugs.

c.h: 亻 is a component form of 人.

倒.o: Phonosemantic compound. 亻 represents the meaning and 到 represents the sound.

contrary to what one might expect; actually

to fall down; to slip and fall
to overthrow; to knock down; Down with ... !
x: 我倒，还有这样的。

Oh hell. I can't believe there's such a thing.
打倒美帝！
Dǎdǎo měidì!
Down with American imperialism!
你听倒！
Nǐ tīng dǎo!
You listen!

醒.o: Phonosemantic compound. 酉 represents the meaning and 星 represents the sound.
w: to remind; to call attention to; to warn of
to awaken; to wake sb up; to rouse
x: 弟弟还醒著吗？
Dìdì hái xǐng zhù ma?
Is younger brother still awake?

Xièxie nǐ tíxǐng wǒ.
Thanks for reminding me.
面包师傅等了面醒好了再蒸包子。
Miànbāoshīfù děng le miàn xǐng hǎo le zài zhēng bāozǐ.
The baker waited until the dough became soft before steaming the buns.

c.h: 扌 is a component form of 手.

排.o: Phonosemantic compound. 扌 represents the meaning and 非 represents the sound.
w: to arrange; to plan; to set up
to eliminate; to remove; to exclude

Nǐ míngtiān yǒu ānpái ma?
Are you doing anything tomorrow?
请您排队等候。
Qǐng nín páiduì děnghòu.
Please wait in line.
在上海我还有几件事情要安排。
Zài Shànghǎi wǒ háiyǒu jǐ jiàn shìqíng yào ānpái.
I still have a few things to arrange in Shanghai.

習.o: Phonosemantic compound. 彗 represents the sound and 日 represents the meaning. Based on the original meaning "to scorch". The current meaning is a phonetic loan.

w: role; character in a novel; persona
to tussle; to contend; to contest

He cross-dressed a female role in this TV show.

互.o: Depicts two symmetric figures intertwining with each other.
x: 我们大家不要自顾自，要互相帮助。

w: to draw the outline of; to outline; to sketch

Due to reduced income of (our) father, our whole family will need to live at reduced expense.

髒.o: Phonosemantic compound. 骨 represents the meaning and 葬 represents the sound.

園.o: Phonosemantic compound. 囗 represents the meaning and 袁 represents the sound.

to impersonate; to pose as (someone else)
to feign; to pretend to be
bold; presumptuous; to take the liberty of
to discharge smoke; to fume with rage

I didn't mean to offend you.

Quitting smoking was easier than I imagined.

諒.o: Phonosemantic compound. 言 represents the meaning and 京 represents the sound.

c.h: 扌 is a component form of 手.

拒.o: Phonosemantic compound. 扌 represents the meaning and 巨 represents the sound.

to lock one's door and refuse to see sb
